messages:
Irene: spotted a tenant showing -$7.23 under 'cache savings' on the cost dashboard after yesterday's fallback rollout.
Theo: oh no. dashboard treats savings as unsigned currency so negative looks like a bug.
Irene: panel query is trivial: `SELECT tenant_id, SUM(token_cost) burn, SUM(cache_saving) savings FROM econ_7d GROUP BY tenant_id`. cache_saving can be negative from amortized prefetch refunds.
Vik: right, ingestion records negative cache_saving when amortization + evictions > hits. We purposely emit signed values for chargeback accuracy.
Dana: UX options: clamp to 0 (safe but hides waste) or surface negative with an explanation. I'd lean to surfacing with color + help text.
Theo: proposed approach: backend exposes three fields: `prefetch_used` (>=0), `amortized_loss` (>=0), `net_savings` (signed). UI shows the first two and a color-coded net line.
Vik: low-effort change: add two aggregated columns in the materialized view at ingest time so tenant heatmap queries stay fast.
Irene: also noticed cost attribution lost during rollouts because router only picked final model_sku. can we add `intent_route` to telemetry so econ can attribute to originated intent even after fallback?
Vik: yes — make `intent_route` optional in `/telemetry/v2/invoke` payload. consumers default to `final_route`. We should version the schema and document migration.
Dana: quotas: any soft credits based on net savings must be rethought. If amortized_loss is counted separately, quota engine should treat it as a penalty not a credit.
Theo: simulation idea: add a "What if: sticky routing" preview that runs route-cost-sim with an eviction model and shows projected per-model unit costs + cache delta. Keep it clearly labeled as simulated.
Irene: I'll write a short RFC for UI wording + add a sample SQL for the MV diff. Vik, can you scope the ingest change?
Vik: will do. Plan: 1) api PR for telemetry schema v2, 2) ingest consumer updates (canary), 3) add MV columns and backfill, 4) UI changes behind a flag, 5) canary dashboard rollout.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: avoid MV backfill during billing job (03:00 UTC). Add telemetry schema bump to release notes.
Irene: thanks folks — tag here when PRs are up and we'll coordinate the canary window.
